item.title: Over 7,000 recipients of Jobseekers' allowance across region
item.description: There are over 7,000 recipients of jobseeker's allowance in the Shannonside Northern Sound region. Figures were revealed earlier this week following a parliamentary question from Deputy Malcom Byrne to Minister for Social Protection, Dara Calleary. Jobseeker's allowance is a means-tested social assistance payment for people who are unemployed, or working part-time for 3 days a week or less, and are actively seeking full-time work. item.title: Local TD says more Garda recruitment 'not the solution' to crime in Co. Longford
item.description: A local TD says more Garda recruitment is not the solution to preventing crime in Co. Longford. Fine Gael TD Micheál Carrigy's comments come following a double stabbing in the county town on Monday, during which two men suffered serious injuries. The Irish Independent reports Gardaí are investigating whether a convicted criminal who recently returned to the country was behind the incident, which saw a Dublin-based gang arrive into the town. item.title: Roscommon property developer praised in the Seanad for new apprenticeship bursary
item.description: Roscommon property developer Sean Mulryan has been praised in the Seanad for his new apprenticeship bursary. The 500,000 euro fund will encourage young people to take up construction apprenticeships. It's available for five years for people who were born, educated or are living in Roscommon.
